# Localix Grammar

> Localix Grammar is an open source Chrome extension that proofreads text in web editors with a model the user picks on OpenRouter: it fixes spelling, grammar and punctuation, shows each change as a tracked edit, and applies them in one click.

One check is one request: the model returns the corrected text, and the extension derives every
suggestion by comparing it with the original. The OpenRouter key stays in the extension's storage;
text is sent only when a check runs, only to OpenRouter and the selected model. It is installed
from source (https://github.com/localixai/localix-grammar), MIT-licensed, and made by Localix Lab
(https://localix.ai).
